API Keys
eBird API Key
Not configured
No key saved
Get a free key at ebird.org/api/keygen (sign in to your eBird account first).
OpenWeather API Key
Not configured
No key saved
Create a key at openweathermap.org, then subscribe it to the free “One Call by Call” plan. Weather lookups fail without that subscription.

Keys are stored in the server's .env file and take effect immediately; no restart needed. They stay configured across app restarts.

Default Files
eBird Backup
Your eBird sightings export, used across most tabs
No file saved
ML Export
Your Macaulay Library export, powers the Multimedia tab
No file saved

Files are stored on this server and load automatically when you open the relevant tab.

Help & Documentation
SnowRaven Documentation
Setup guides, feature walkthroughs, and API key instructions. Available offline.
Appearance
Color scheme
Text size

Scale text throughout the app (up to 200%). Also follows your device's text-size setting.

Date format

How dates are shown throughout the app.

Disable embedded media

Prevents inline Macaulay Library players from loading. Direct media links remain available.

Sharing
Copying a location

What gets copied when you copy a location from a map pin. Coordinates are decimal degrees to five places, latitude first.

Coordinates
Google Maps link
Apple Maps link
Example
38.54321, -121.98765
Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?q=38.54321,-121.98765
Apple Maps: https://maps.apple.com/?q=38.54321,-121.98765

Three lines: coordinates, Google Maps link, Apple Maps link.

Default Location

Set a home location for the Map Explorer. These coordinates load automatically every time you open the map tab.

Tab Layout

Drag a row, or use the Move up / Move down buttons, to reorder. Use the eye icon to show or hide individual tabs. On phones the first four shown here become the bottom bar; the rest live under More.

  • Weather
  • Statistics
  • Map Explorer
  • Species Detail
  • Calendar
  • Targets
  • Multimedia
  • Breeding Codes
  • Checklists
  • List Comparer
  • Named Birds
Settingsalways last
Bar-chart files

County bar-chart files added on the Targets tab, for sorting by eBird frequency.

No bar-chart files are saved on this server.

For creating a wonderful platform for tracking birding data, and for making it freely available.
